Gold.note: Strong central bank buying and macro hedging support elevated prices.

Silver.note: Dual industrial and monetary demand driving outperformance versus gold.

Copper.note: Tight concentrate markets and green energy transition underpin steady demand.

Uranium.note: Structural supply deficit persists despite near-term price consolidation.

Lithium.note: Ongoing supply surplus and EV demand growth normalization weigh on sentiment.

Nickel.note: Persistent Indonesian supply growth offsets rising battery-grade demand.

Zinc.note: Smelter treatment charge collapses indicate severe concentrate tightness.

Iron Ore.note: Weak Chinese property sector demand offsets infrastructure stimulus expectations.

Coal.note: Balanced seaborne market with stable thermal and met coal demand.

Rare Earths.note: Oversupply from China and subdued EV motor demand cap upside.

Manganese.note: Soft global steel production margins limit manganese ore demand.

PGM.note: Weak global auto production and ongoing platinum-palladium substitution.

Potash.note: Stable global agricultural application rates balance normalized supply.

Aluminum.note: Chinese capacity caps and renewable energy demand tighten primary supply.

Diversified.note: Balanced portfolio exposure offsets idiosyncratic risks in single commodities.
